summary: Frequency Electronics filed an 8-K disclosing a completed underwritten public offering of 1,739,131 shares at $57.50 per share. The company sold 1,086,957 shares, and selling stockholders Edenbrook Value Fund and Edenbrook Long Only Value Fund sold 652,174 shares. Gross proceeds to the company were approximately $62.5 million; underwriters, led by Morgan Stanley, hold a 30-day option for 260,869 additional shares. This is a routine capital raise by the issuer, not a special-situation transaction. The filing includes standard underwriting agreements and legal opinions. No extraordinary strategic or structural event is present.
